basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon, with a keen interest in data storage solutions and network configurations. I work as a systems administrator for a mid-sized tech company, where I manage server infrastructure and data migrations. In my free time, I enjoy building custom PC setups and exploring the latest in NAS technology. I'm single and usually online during the late evenings, often browsing through tech forums and subreddits to keep up with the latest trends and solutions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and over five years of experience in IT infrastructure management. My expertise lies in server setups, RAID configurations, and network solutions. I frequently engage in self-learning through online courses and forums to stay updated with the latest in technology.
